fields.Name: IT30 - Conversation Compaction (assembly layer)
fields.Description: Deterministic coverage of PR #2732's cross-turn conversation compaction assembly layer, graduated from the standalone conversation-compaction-tests.ts dispatcher into the shared registry (bundle 'conversation-compaction', CC1-CC12). CC1: the trgConversationDetail_AssignSequence trigger assigns per-conversation monotonic Sequence through real spCreate. CC2-CC6: ConversationEngine.GetAgentContextWindow — no-boundary passthrough, maxTailMessages cap, boundary selection at the highest non-null SummaryOfEarlierConversation with warm-cache coherency after an external save, recursive highest-wins, and excludeDetailIds placeholder filtering. CC7: the retrieval tools (getMessageBySequence / getMessagesByRange / searchConversation) page and search the full stored history. CC8: independent per-conversation sequence spaces. CC9: a completed-at-creation 'Compaction' run step persists via a SINGLE INSERT (__mj_UpdatedAt === __mj_CreatedAt). CC10: the prior-turn tool-result carry-forward loader — DB fallback finds an AwaitingFeedback prior run, cache precedence on hit, agent-scoped provenance both directions, and settle-time cache population. CC11: AssembleContextWindow parity between the engine window, an independent hand-built ConversationWindowFields query, AND the production LoadWindowRowsFresh loader (previously never invoked by any test). CC12: BREAK ATTEMPT — concurrent same-conversation inserts still receive distinct consecutive Sequences (the trigger's UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK serialization path). NO LLM calls. Mutation-by-design: creates and FK-ordered-deletes its own tagged Conversations/Details/Agent Runs/Run Steps.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Sequence assignment is monotonic and concurrency-safe; context windows fold identically across the warm cache, fresh queries, and the production loader; compaction steps persist in one INSERT; carry-forward results stay agent-scoped.
